limitations: Review categories are prototype readiness cues, not approved action triggers, risk scores, flood probabilities, inundation boundaries, travel times or deployment recommendations. A positive change at display precision may be very small; magnitudes remain visible.

No county action thresholds, staging sites, safe access routes, equipment quantities, decision owners or response lead times are configured. NWS and responsible operators must validate these before operational adoption.
Rainfall is sampled at the existing eleven stations; it is not complete upstream basin coverage. The three-day cue window intentionally does not change when the operator displays the seven-day layer.
Gauge forecasts may already incorporate precipitation and operations. Combining them does not create independent corroboration or a calibrated multi-source forecast.
Reported releases are observations; future schedules are not ingested. Basin connectivity, diversions and bypass operation are not routed. No below-Pine-Flat gauge is connected.
Foreground refresh only. No push notifications, SMS/email, saved review history, team acknowledgement, background paging or automatic assignments.
Fault cases were verified with model tests and isolated browser fixtures. Every real-world network outage/browser/GPU combination has not been fault-injected.
Phone verification used a simulated viewport; physical-device, full keyboard and assistive-technology acceptance remain county tasks.
GitHub Pages remains undeployed and OAuth Client ID unconfigured. Existing public-source prototype and Experience Builder pilot remain separate.
rollback: Restore v0.5.0 archive or revert the release commit in the future GitHub repository; no hosted operational data was modified.
